introduction: We are a community inspired by the Theravada tradition and the Buddha’s teachings.
body: Northwest Meditation Center welcomes people from all backgrounds who are interested in learning about the Theravada Buddhist tradition. Our retreats offer time away in a supportive community.
peopleNote: Our teachers and board members help guide the center and its retreat community.

people.name: Ven. Sumanā
people.bio: Shares Dhamma reflections and guides the center’s retreat program.

people.name: Ven. Ānanda
people.bio: Offers teachings rooted in the Theravada tradition.

people.name: Maya Chen
people.bio: Helps care for the center and its community programs.
